pipeline.soft_subs_required: Toggleable subtitles require MP4 or MKV. AVI and WMV are not supported. WebM burns subtitles into the frame and cannot be turned off.
ffmpeg.no_audio_message:
ffmpeg does not see an audio track inside the selected MP4.

A common cause is a file after Topaz Video AI (names like *_prob4*, *_enhanced*): video was enhanced but audio was not included. The player may have played another file or the original nearby.

You can choose another file with audio (original video) — subtitles will still be muxed into the selected video.
ffmpeg.not_found:
ffmpeg not found.

1. Run install_ffmpeg.ps1 in the program folder
2. Or: winget install Gyan.FFmpeg
3. Or place ffmpeg.exe in the bin folder
ffmpeg.broken:
ffmpeg was found but does not respond (possibly a Windows stub).

{paths}
